notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We have fixed some issues that hopefully improve your experience with the game.

Issues solved:
- Fixed going between Options and other menus, sometimes made both invisible
- Fixed Character Keyboard Locks display more correctly when switching between controller and keyboard.
- Fixed problem with going between characters in Character Select, when using a controller.
- Moved the Ready bar so players can see their Keyboard Lock.

Temporary fix:
- Disabled Reverse Dash as a Mutator. Caused characters to get stuck in each other when colliding head-on!

If you have encountered any problems and wish to report them to use, then create a thread in the Community Hub and post it in the Bug Report forum And in the description describe the problem you encountered! If you have a video of the problem please submit it alongside the feedback.
